title: Add Glucose Direction and Delta
symptom: The issue requests adding glucose trending direction and glucose delta value with time period as Automation Trigger types in AAPS 3.
fix: The thread indicates that the requested functionality already exists as a 'BG difference' trigger, allowing selection of Delta / Short avg. delta / Long avg. delta and the amount with comparison operators.
evidence_quote: It already exists (trigger BG difference) You can select Delta / Short avg. delta / Long avg. delta. and the amount (is equal / is greater than / ...)
